note: core_budget is the cluster cap of the plant: of the laptop's 8 logical CPUs (4 physical cores), about 3 are left to kind, the gateway, the embedder, PostgreSQL, tier-lb, Prometheus and the host-side load generator. The scheduler also refuses a model-server pod that does not fit the node's allocatable CPU (the pods are Guaranteed), but that limit sits near 6 cores, so this budget, not the scheduler, is the binding constraint. cores_per_pod must equal the Deployment's CPU limit and llama-server --threads (static check: scripts/validate_static.py).
